related_questions.question: When a creditworthy business takes on an unsecured short-term loan, which kind of interest rate will it likely be charged?

text_blocks.snippet: A creditworthy business taking on an unsecured, short-term loan will likely be charged the prime interest rate plus a percentage or two, according to multiple finance Q&A sites. This is because unsecured loans carry more risk for the lender, but a good credit score lowers that risk. The "prime rate" is a benchmark interest rate that large banks charge their most creditworthy corporate borrowers.
